title: Automated tests

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Automated tests check that important behavior survives changes and catch regressions before users encounter them.
CORE EXPLANATION
Tests encode expected behavior and check it after changes. unittest is in the standard library; each test should cover a behavior and clean up temporary files.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Test boundary cases and empty inputs, not only the happy path.

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: Never log passwords, tokens, or personal data; a type hint is not runtime validation.
COMMON MISTAKES
Keep tests deterministic and make log levels and type contracts explicit.
